note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: Oversized knit sweaters, turtlenecks, blazers, trench coats and wool coats, wide-leg trousers, pleated midi skirts, loafers, ballet flats and ankle boots, in neutral tones: navy, brown, black, beige, olive.
trends.title: Fall outfit vibes: layered autumn dressing

trends.details: White sectional sofas, chunky knit blankets, lit candles, chandeliers, wood ceilings and fireplaces; warm, inviting autumn atmosphere. A second popular thread: moody makeovers with dark fireplaces, cognac leather sofas, Persian-style rugs, brass accents and velvet curtains.
trends.title: Cozy fall living rooms

trends.details: The 2026 look: softer defined brows, breathable 'porcelain doll' skin, lifted concealer instead of heavy contour, soft-sculpted blush, glam half-lash, targeted highlight, fuller lips finished with gloss. Nostalgia for 2016 full glam runs alongside it.
trends.title: 2026 soft natural makeup vs 2016 glam
